item.title: Show HN: I built an economy designed to crash
item.summary: This is an experiment designed to be broken by the public, so, feel free to exploit however you please. The experiment is basically just a limited free supply that gets mined by the public, the cumulative total is between 100-10000 of the currency, so a harder cap then bitcoin at 21 Million, once the total free supply runs out, trading begins and my theories dont go that far so the economy is either bound to boom or crash hard. Happy experimenting! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49180864 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
